messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV cache footprint spike detected on pool-prod-eu (awq-int8 kernel path). paging_threshold=0.85 breached, paging_rate up 220% :warning:

maya: oncall taking. seeing paging alarms + token latency tail. starting investigation.

jonah: timeline — 2123456700 deploy landed for model-awq-v2 (AWQ int8 kernels). ~5m after, kv_size per-request increased ~3-4x, continuous-batching queue length spiked, triggers paging. looks like kernel selection changed behavior for long sequences.

arif: adding context from perf evals — AWQ quant path had a regression in KV encoding: small keys ended up padded to 4x the expected size for GPT-like attention patterns. reproducing locally with the repro prompt.

maya: logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T09:05:12Z] kv_cache: alloc 12MB -> 48MB (per-seq)
[2026-03-15T09:05:16Z] cont_batch: queue_len 240 -> 970
[2026-03-15T09:05:18Z] paging: active=15 shards, rate=320/s
```

lisa: @maya FYI I'm nearby and will take the handoff in 10 if you need to jump to PD.

maya: handing off to @lisa — I'm on a customer call. latest actions: throttled cont-batching to max 4 concurrent batches per GPU, lowered max_batch_tokens to 512, enabled aggressive kv-eviction. still seeing some paging but growth slowed.

lisa: thanks. next steps: 1) force kernel fallback to legacy fp16 path for awq models via runtime flag 2) patch scheduler to disable the new awq kernel selection for prod pools 3) roll back canary if kernel fallback not immediate. I'll try kernel fallback first since it's the least disruptive.

jonah: kernel fallback command (runtime):
```
curl -X POST https://runtime-api.internal/v1/admin/kernel_override \
  -d '{"model":"model-awq-v2","kernel_path":"fp16_v1","reason":"kv_footprint_spike"}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job 9876 started for revert-awq-kernel-hotfix (pr#4521) by jonah. CI checks queued.

lisa: applied kernel_override on pool-prod-eu. monitoring.

arif: early metrics: kv_size per-request dropping back toward baseline within a single adjacency window. cont-batch queue draining. paging_rate trending down. great.

sam: customer impact quick check — pinged top requesters:
- acme-inc: minor latency bump ~700ms for a 10m window, no errors reported.
- mediata: experienced 503s for a short window during peak, CS already engaged and sent incident notice.
- partner-labs: some retries observed, engineering on their side did backoff.

maya: adding to the incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/2123456789 — I'll capture timeline + root cause. Can someone paste the exact PR/rollout ids?

jonah: PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4521 (revert awq kernel selection). Rollout: deploy job 9876 -> started 2123456795, rollback window initiated.

lisa: current status: paging alarms cleared, tail latency mostly recovered. Keeping throttles for 30m to ensure stability. Recommend postmortem to dig into quant conversion tests + kernel selection heuristics.

arif: root cause hypothesis: AWQ int8 kernel introduced an unexpected KV packing change (padding alignment) that increased on-device KV footprint for certain attention configs. Kernel selection went live without a regression in kv-size synthetic tests. Need unit test that asserts KV per-seq memory distribution across sequence lengths.

maya: customers impacted list (to be expanded): acme-inc, mediata, partner-labs, curiousai. Sam will coordinate outreach.

sam: I'll draft templated notice and notify enterprise CS. severity: S2 (service impact for subset of customers).

lisa: action items assigned:
- jonah/arif: create regression unit test + fix quant packing (PR target: hotfix/kv-pack-458)
- eng-runtime: add a runtime canary that measures per-request kv footprint on canaries before full kernel flip
- eng-sre: add automated alert that correlates kv_size spikes + cont-batch queue len to reduce alert noise but catch regressions earlier
- product: prepare customer comms for impacted tenants

jonah: starting on the fix. will link PR here.

deploy-bot: Deploy job 9882 finished: PR 4521 reverted in canary pools.

lisa: leaving throttles in place. handoff back to maya in 25m.

maya: back and taking incident owner. preparing post-incident follow-up. Thanks all for quick response :bow:

sam: customer notices sent, support cases opened for mediata.

arif: note for postmortem — add tests for AWQ/GPTQ/INT8 KV packing vs fp16; include perf cliff scenarios with long context; test continuous-batching interactions.

lisa: incident closed for now; tracking on the incident doc. will reconvene in 48h for follow-up review.

incident-bot: Incident 2123456789 status -> mitigated (paging cleared, kernel fallback applied).
